reviews.title: Solid build, great sound, dual wireless connection.
reviews.comment: Looks, feels, and sounds beautiful. Solid build, easy volume wheels, the semitone works well for room awareness. The microphone sounds clean and loud with the noise filter, my friends say it sounds better than my old Sony Pulse 3D headset. The dual simultaneous dongle + Bluetooth is a game changer, can take calls while playing, or hear music and audiobooks, etc. The light mute indicator on the microphone is great.  My only problem is that the mute button has a loud sharp beep every time it’s pushed in or out, I dunno if it can be adjusted. The earpads are comfortable and breathe well to stay cool and it doesn’t have that faux leather coating that eventually peels off and looks ugly. I feel like I got a good deal vs my previous headset (Sony Pulse Elite), it has mostly the same features but the build quality is much better with the Nova as my Elite broke on the headband in less than a month, even with careful handling.

reviews.title: Amazing Comfort but Sound Quality is from 2002
reviews.comment:
I wanna start out by saying that this headset feels high-quality and has unbelievable comfort, however, that means nothing if the sound quality is poor. I bought this headset a couple weeks ago to replace a cheap Walmart headset I bought. On the wired mode this headset works phenomenally, but on the wireless mode, it sounds like my volume is turned down or some setting is not working properly. I downloaded all the software and messed with all the settings watch dozens of videos and read multiple Reddit post and was not able to get any fixes.
I’m extremely disappointed with this headset as I typically don’t spend lots of money on peripherals. This is my first expensive headset and I would not recommend whatsoever. I would recommend a hyper X over this sunny day.
reviews.author: Richard b.

reviews.title: Almost a perfect headset
reviews.comment: I would give it 5 stars if it wasn't for the mic picking up all that background noise. I love the headphone quality and it's a comfortable set. The sound quality of games is decent but the mic is too sensitive in picking up background noise but for spatial sound and single player games I recommend this Steelseries but for competitive online gaming, other options can be more beneficial.
